title: Lightwell v0 product decisions
objective: Resolve and record product choices separately from engineering, retaining accepted S0 decisions and supporting the history-first editor milestones and later scoped work.
context_summary: Accepted S0 and editor decisions plus unresolved product questions. The planned editor sequence is history foundation, transforms, tool modules and crop; later workflow, RAW, external-module and performance decisions remain open. Task IDs and dependencies are local to this file.

tasks.description: Maintain the owner decision interview and record the consequences of each answer.
extra_context: Ongoing product interview. The accepted viewer is followed by history foundation, basic transforms, tool modules and crop; later choices are not prerequisites for starting the history model.
Preserve accepted behavior in docs/decisions.md and docs/design/history-first-roadmap.md. Planning is proportionate to scope; this coordination task is not a universal execution gate.

tasks.description: Define the S0 operating-system, architecture and verification matrix.
extra_context: Owner accepted macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64 and Linux x64 with unsigned development artifacts on 2026-09-19.

Delegated baseline selection is recorded in docs/engineering/platforms.md: macOS 14+ arm64, Windows 11 24H2+ x64 and Ubuntu 24.04 x64 GNOME Wayland/X11. This completes the decision; verification remains separately recorded.
Manual Windows/Linux desktop checks are deferred by owner instruction; no native performance claim follows.

tasks.description: Set the minimal skeleton layout and loading/error behavior.
